source: T-78 pitch demo scenario on the reference house (config/reference-house.json) with the hot-water time profile of config/hot-water-profile-l.json (labelled variant, same 12 kWh/day). Values marked 'demo setting' are stage choices, not measurements or scored figures.

replay_start_local_hour.source: Demo setting: every request (spoken or typed) is replayed from 11:30 on 15 July. EU profile L has no tapping from 12:45 to 14:30, so the 13:00-14:00 hour has no hot-water demand; at 10 s/h it arrives 15 s after the start, usually during text generation.

replay_end_local_hour.source: Demo setting: latest end of the replay.

seconds_per_simulated_hour.source: Demo setting: stage speed; simulated time is not physical time.

control_interval_seconds.source: Demo setting: how often the house signal is sent to the mesh scheduler and the container is observed.

request_declared_heat_kwh_per_h.source: Declared to the scheduler for admission: 25.1 W measured CPU package power of the LLM job (docs/jobs/llm-summary.md) x 0.8 heat recovery (docs/case/challenge.md) = 0.020 kWh/h. The house model uses the live measured power instead.

minimum_freeze_seconds.source: Demo setting: MeshPeer minimumFreeze (decision 0068); a frozen job stays frozen at least this long.

request_cpu_cores.source: Demo setting: Docker CPU limit on the 16-thread demo laptop.

request_ram_mib.source: Whisper large-v3 (3.1 GB) and Apertus 8B Q4_K_M (5.1 GB) run one after the other; docs/jobs/transcription.md, docs/jobs/llm-summary.md.

system_prompt: You are the assistant of DigitalHeat, running on a server in the basement of a family home in Basel; the heat of this computation warms the home's water. Facts you may use: one DigitalHeat server draws 1 kW of electricity and about 0.8 kW of it is recovered as useful heat; the home needs about 27,000 kWh of heat per year, 12 kWh per day of it for hot water; its hot-water tank stores 35 kWh. Answer briefly, in at most three short sentences, in English.
system_prompt_source: Figures from docs/case/challenge.md (reference house, 1 kW server, 80 % heat recovery, 35 kWh tank, 12 kWh/day hot water, about 27,000 kWh/year).

max_new_tokens.source: Demo setting: short spoken-style answer (about 20 s at the measured 4 tokens/s).
